description:
## Description
This figure illustrates the concept of bounding box prediction in the YOLOv3 model. It shows how the width and height of a bounding box are predicted as offsets from cluster centroids. The center coordinates of the box are predicted relative to the filter application location using a sigmoid function. The figure includes a grid with a blue square representing the bounding box, and annotations explaining the prediction process.

description:
## Description
This figure is a line graph comparing the speed and accuracy of various object detection methods, measured by mAP (mean Average Precision) at 0.5 IOU (Intersection over Union) metric. The x-axis represents inference time in milliseconds, and the y-axis represents mAP score. YOLOv3 is the highest performing method, achieving the highest mAP score of 58 while maintaining the lowest inference time of 50 ms. RetinaNet-101-800 is the second highest, with an mAP score of 57.5 and an inference time of 198 ms.
